subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Preterm Labour, Tocolysis, Steroids and PPROM

steps.tx: Labour with cervical change before thirty seven completed weeks is **preterm labour**. It drives most neonatal mortality and disability worldwide. Distinguishing true labour from false alarms avoids unnecessary admissions and steroids. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Preterm labour changes the cervix before thirty seven weeks and drives neonatal disability.

steps.tx: Drugs suppressing contractions to gain forty eight hours for steroids form **tocolysis**. The aim is never long term delay but a window for corticosteroids and transfer. Maintenance tocolysis does not improve outcomes. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Tocolysis gains forty eight hours for steroids and transfer, never long term delay.

steps.tx: The calcium channel blocker most used as first line tocolytic is **nifedipine**. Oral loading then maintenance suppresses contractions with a friendly side effect profile. It must not combine casually with magnesium infusions. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: Nifedipine is the first line tocolytic with a friendly side effect profile.

steps.tx: The oxytocin receptor antagonist designed specifically for tocolysis is **atosiban**. It has the fewest maternal side effects of any tocolytic. Cost limits its use where nifedipine serves equally well. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Atosiban blocks oxytocin receptors with the fewest maternal side effects but high cost.

steps.tx: Injections maturing fetal lungs before preterm birth are **antenatal corticosteroids**. Betamethasone two doses twenty four hours apart is the classic course. They halve respiratory distress and neonatal death when delivery follows within a week. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Antenatal corticosteroids halve respiratory distress when delivery follows within a week.

steps.tx: The standard steroid for lung maturity given as two intramuscular doses is **betamethasone**. Dexamethasone in four doses is the accepted alternative where betamethasone is unavailable. Repeat courses are restricted to selected ongoing high risk cases. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Betamethasone in two doses is standard, with dexamethasone as accepted alternative.

steps.tx: Magnesium before early preterm birth protects the fetal brain, termed **magnesium neuroprotection**. Given below thirty two weeks it reduces cerebral palsy. It runs alongside tocolysis and steroids in threatened early delivery. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Magnesium neuroprotection below thirty two weeks reduces cerebral palsy.

steps.tx: A placental protein in vaginal fluid predicting delivery within a fortnight is **fetal fibronectin**. A negative test powerfully reassures that delivery is unlikely in seven to fourteen days. Cervical length under twenty five millimetres on scan carries similar weight, and vaginal progesterone prevents preterm birth in short cervix, while antibiotics prolong latency after preterm membrane rupture and steroids plus surveillance watch for chorioamnionitis.
steps.say: Fetal fibronectin negativity reassures against delivery within a fortnight.

steps.tx: Membrane rupture before labour and before term is PPROM, managed with **latency antibiotics** prolonging pregnancy safely. Erythromycin based regimens extend latency and improve neonatal outcomes, while co-amoxiclav is avoided for necrotising enterocolitis risk. Post term pregnancy beyond forty two weeks is induced because stillbirth risk climbs, and membrane sweeping from forty weeks nudges labour naturally.
steps.say: Latency antibiotics prolong PPROM pregnancy safely while post term pregnancy is induced.
